rows.text_1_facilitator:
There are four steps to building a family budget. 💰You have already covered:
1️⃣ Step 1: identifying needs and wants.
2️⃣ Step 2: talking about monthly expenses.

3️⃣ Today, you will learn Step 3: making a monthly budget.

text_1_facilitator.eng:
There are four steps to building a family budget. 💰You have already covered:
1️⃣ Step 1: identifying needs and wants.
2️⃣ Step 2: talking about monthly expenses.

3️⃣ Today, you will learn Step 3: making a monthly budget.

text_2.eng: Balancing the money you earn with the money you need to spend is an important step in making a monthly budget. 📝

rows.text_2: Balancing the money you earn with the money you need to spend is an important step in making a monthly budget. 📝

rows.text_1_facilitator: Here is how you can build a monthly budget.

text_1_facilitator.eng: Here is how you can build a monthly budget.

rows.text_1_facilitator: 🎨 Take the piece of paper from the monthly expenses activity that shows all the things you spend money on during a month.

text_1_facilitator.eng: 🎨 Take the piece of paper from the monthly expenses activity that shows all the things you spend money on during a month.

rows.text_1_facilitator: 💰 Add up all the money your family has available each month. This can be from a job, welfare grants, or even money sent to the family by other relatives.

text_1_facilitator.eng: 💰 Add up all the money your family has available each month. This can be from a job, welfare grants, or even money sent to the family by other relatives.

rows.text_1_facilitator: 📱🚲 Decide which of the expenses are things that you NEED and which are things that you WANT. 📺🍞🚗

text_1_facilitator.eng: 📱🚲 Decide which of the expenses are things that you NEED and which are things that you WANT. 📺🍞🚗

rows.text_1_facilitator: ⭐ Draw a star next to everything that you NEED. Add up all the things that have a star next to it.

text_1_facilitator.eng: ⭐ Draw a star next to everything that you NEED. Add up all the things that have a star next to it.

rows.text_1_facilitator:
💡 Is the amount more or less than your monthly budget? 

⬆️ If it is less, you can add some things that you WANT. 

⬇️ If it is more, then you may want to discuss with your child which things are really NEEDS. 

😔 You may need to make difficult choices between different things. 💚

rows.text_1_facilitator: 5️⃣ Here are the five steps to make a monthly budget!

text_1_facilitator.eng: 5️⃣ Here are the five steps to make a monthly budget!

section_1_text.eng:
📝 With your family, make a list of things that you cannot live without. These are things that are important for your family to survive. 
⭐ For example: food 🍚, medicine 🩹, or laundry detergent 🫧.

section_2_text.eng:
🎁 Make a list of things that you or others want. These are things that would be nice to have but not essential. 
⭐ For example: the latest version of a smartphone 📱, new toy 🧸, or a new car 🚗.

section_3_text.eng:
👀 People often see things in different ways. 
📝 You may find that your family members see one thing as a NEED while you see it as a WANT. 
💰 Talk with your family about why you feel differently. This will help you to understand each other and can make decisions together about what to spend money on.
